written: Guides below are this entry's own words, written for the Leonida Ledger. Walkthrough facts come from PowerPyx's GTA 6 trophy guide (linked per trophy); names, descriptions and grades are the official list as Exophase and PSNProfiles publish it.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are earned. It needs no multiplayer and no DLC: every trophy in the set is offline single-player, so the platinum is purely a matter of finishing the list. PowerPyx rates the whole set 4/10 and about 200 hours.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy: finish the first main mission, Gone Fishing, in Chapter 1 and it pops. PowerPyx lists it as unmissable, so just play the opening and it is yours.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy: play through Chapter 1 to its end. PowerPyx has it unlocking as Chapter 2 opens with the mission What's in the Bag?, and it cannot be missed.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy: finish Chapter 2. PowerPyx has it popping as Chapter 3 begins with Welcome to Vice City. Keep a manual save at the start of each chapter (15 slots exist) in case you want to revisit anything, but the trophy itself cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy: finish Chapter 3. PowerPyx has it unlocking after the first two missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life, and it cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy: finish Chapter 4. PowerPyx has it unlocking after the chapter's final mission, Starting From Zero. There are no difficulty settings and no mission gold medals to worry about on the way.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy: finish the final mission and the credits roll. PowerPyx lists it as unmissable, and it is the only gold trophy tied to the story itself; the other gold is A Long Road for 100% completion.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy: complete the main mission Breakfast Run in Chapter 2. PowerPyx lists it as unmissable, so it pops as part of playing the story.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy: complete the main mission The Cartel Heist in Chapter 3. PowerPyx lists it as unmissable; it pops when the heist ends.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy: complete the main mission Child's Play in Chapter 4. PowerPyx lists it as unmissable.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy: complete the main mission Headliners in Chapter 4. PowerPyx lists it as unmissable.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy: complete the main mission VCIA Takedown in Chapter 4. PowerPyx lists it as unmissable; it pops when the takedown ends.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy: complete the main mission Operation Savage Glory in Chapter 5. PowerPyx lists it as unmissable, so it comes with the story.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The hardest trophy in the set, per PowerPyx, and the long pole of the platinum: reach 100% on the checklist under Progress, Stats, 100% Completion, which only appears after the story. The bar is lenient — PowerPyx puts it near 60% of true completion: any 100 optional missions, scan 200 of 277 base-model vehicles, study 100 of 255 animals with the binoculars, and any 70 of 80 challenges. Progress made during the story already counts, and nothing on the checklist is missable.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts in the game; the 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going past this one. PowerPyx breaks the set down as 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridges, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps, and calls under-the-bridges the quickest of the four. Track progress per region under Progress, Activities, Stunts, and find named stunts on the map under Exploration, Stunt Spots.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: The trophy tracker counts 9 activity types, and you need one of each: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball (scoring hoops), playing a video game, winning a car race or race challenge or Top Fun drone race, and performing a stunt. PowerPyx says you will do one of each almost automatically while chasing the other trophies and the 100% checklist, so check Touchpad, Progress, Activities to see which types you still owe.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across 12 range locations. PowerPyx notes the golds are not too difficult and that shooting-range play also raises your Focus level, which helps the Gunslinger trophy. Work through the ranges after the story, when you have better weapons.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations; PowerPyx counts 42 drone races in total across them. The 100% checklist wants every drone race won, so this trophy falls out of that grind. Drone races also count toward the race-type activity for Master of None.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races; PowerPyx counts 40 unique race locations, so there is plenty of choice. Each race only needs winning once, and the 100% checklist wants the racing challenges done too, so fold this into the Stage 2 grind rather than chasing it early.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, where you meet Cal, he will text you and mark a fishing spot with a purple map icon. Follow Cal's fishing questline and beat him in a fishing challenge. Fishing also counts as one of the 9 activity types for Master of None.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish all the levels of any one of the 4 arcade games, called Video Games in-game: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind and Bang For Your Buck. The first three are playable on the TV at home from Chapter 1; Bang For Your Buck sits at arcade machines out in the world. You only need to reach the end once — beating every challenge is not required — so pick the game you like best.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's optional questline is Lucia-only and gets marked automatically in Chapter 3: while playing as Lucia you get a call from Andy, then a text with her home address in Belville. Finish all 5 of her quests — Climbing the Cellerichain (parts 1 to 3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass — and the trophy pops on the last one. The quests stay available after the story.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's optional questline gets marked automatically in Chapter 1; a while after the mission Island Dreams he calls you and is marked with a green KR icon in Key Lento. He sends you treasure diving at 7 shipwrecks: follow the purple chest icons, dig the treasure up with the metal detector, and bring it back. Track it under Progress, Characters, Kenton Rees. He goes quiet for a stretch of Chapter 1 and comes back in Chapters 2 to 3, so the line is not missable.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's optional questline gets marked automatically after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. Finish his 5 quests — Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes — and the trophy pops on the last. All of them stay available after the story.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 Strangers & Freaks strands — but only certain questlines count. PowerPyx confirms Kirk (the Skunk Ape hunts), Kyle (McKittrick Farm), Yago (street racing) and Pilot Pete (deliveries) among the counting ones, while Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not count toward this trophy even though they are side quests. Watch the counter in the trophy list itself, and leave this for Stage 3: every counting strand is still there in free-roam after the story.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's Wish List gets marked automatically after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal the Zorrusso for him and unlock the Key Cloner. He wants 16 sports cars delivered; track them under Map, Robberies, Randy's Wish List, and scan cars with the WAiNK app to see if one is on the list. He marks some cars for you, but you can steal them off the street too — Vice Beach and Ocean Beach are good hunting grounds — and he pays more for cars delivered in good condition. The final delivery pops the trophy, and it all stays doable after the story.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone's optional questline is Jason-only and gets marked automatically after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty. Purple markers point at Synthetic Labs around Vice City: go in and destroy them as part of Take Out Kitty Litter. Once enough labs are down, Tyrone hands you the second quest, Spin On This, and finishing it pops the trophy. Everything stays available after the story.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across 10 locations; each spot can be done with both Jason and Lucia, counting as +2, and you can track it under Progress, Collections, Exploration, Meditations. THE ONE TO WATCH: the first meditation only exists in Chapter 1 at Jason's house. After the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning — she says she is going to meditate, walks to the balcony, and you follow and choose Accept. That spot vanishes for good after Chapter 1, and PowerPyx still cannot confirm whether it is required for the trophy, so do it while you can. The 100% checklist only needs 15 of 18 meditations, and the last spot needs both characters playable together, which unlocks after Chapter 2's Coffee Break.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret Vogel's optional questline is Jason-only and gets marked after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when Bret texts you about his first quest, Veteran Hunted, in Lummox County. After that he marks hunting spots with purple icons: hunt the animals he asks for and bring them to him. His first quest hands you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69, retrievable from any weapon locker at Ammu-Nation. There are 15 Target Decks to finish for the 100% checklist, so this line feeds that too; PowerPyx notes it is still unconfirmed exactly which animal pops the trophy, so work the questline through.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete any 3 collectible card sets; PowerPyx counts 18 card set locations in total. Cards are a Stage 2 cleanup job: pick up sets as you sweep the map for other collectibles, and check the linked PowerPyx card guide for the set locations rather than wandering blind.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan any 100 WAiNK locations by holding Up and then R1 while looking at them. PowerPyx counts 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities and 23 sculptures plus the No Flusher tags, so there are well over 100 to choose from — scan whatever you pass. The same app scans vehicles for Whip It Good, so the two trophies progress together.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges; the 100% checklist wants 70, so you will pass this one on the way there. Track them under Progress, Challenges, where scrolling over a challenge shows its completion mark. Most complete naturally while you work the other trophies, so leave the picky ones for last and take the 50 easiest.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Once you can free-roam with your partner — after Chapter 2's Coffee Break, call them with hold Right plus Triangle — build a 4-star wanted level, then drive out of the red heat zone until it pops. PowerPyx's easy escape is the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County: the cops struggle to follow on the tracks and the helicopter cannot see you. It also pops automatically during the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is, since the bank vault robberies there hand you 4-star wanted levels you must escape.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, rob 3 shops in a row while staying wanted the whole time — keep the red and blue flashing wanted level, not the red heat level. A good spot is the 3 jewelry stores in the north of Vice City, unlocked after Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs: rob a couple of items in each, crack the back-room safe with sticky bombs, and move on. The pop is delayed by about half a minute after you leave the third shop, and if it has not fired, hit a fourth shop and keep going.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles — scanning is enough, you never need to drive them. PowerPyx counts 557 vehicles at launch; open the WAiNK app on your phone (hold Up for instant access), look at a vehicle and hold R1 to scan it. A busy road gives you a steady stream, and the 100% checklist wants 200 of 277 base models scanned, so this trophy comes free on the way there. Check totals under Touchpad, Progress, Vehicles.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Combat Focus is L3 plus R3 while aiming: time slows and weak points light up, draining the purple focus bar. You must drop 5 enemies inside one use, so pick a spot with a cluster of them — PowerPyx suggests criminals at gang operations — and use a full-auto rifle like the Duke 556. Buff focus first with food, drink or a wash, and pop Adrenaline (hold L1, then Triangle) to stretch the window. It does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians, and it gets easier as your Focus level rises to 4, which shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots all build.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal one of the large passenger planes docked at a departure terminal at Vice City International Airport — not the ones parked on the airfield, it must be hooked to a boarding bridge. The easiest is the plane at terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence, climb the stairs by the bridge, go upstairs into the cockpit, reverse the plane to the airstrip and take off. Fly about 1 km away from the airport and the trophy pops (it is slightly delayed). You can also walk in through the terminal itself.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank — a Rhino — at Mile Zero Air Station, the island on the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County; the tanks stand in the south of the base. Drive through the gate (or take the stunt jump by the south-east entrance), climb in, and shoot some enemies until the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: First finish Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, which unlocks the Snap Gun for silently picking alarmed doors and marks jewelry store robberies on the map. Slip in through a back door with the Snap Gun instead of kicking it, find the note with the safe code, loot the safe, destroy the security footage and disable the alarm, then leave quietly — the trophy pops shortly after you are out. Richardson Jewelry and Diamonds in Vice City is a good first target.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is first — it teaches bank vault robberies and does the first one for you. After it, tail a security van until it stops at a bank, slip in while the vault is open, and bring your partner: you cannot carry all the cash alone, so hold Right to hand off a bag. Yasmani sells van tips for $10,000 once you have done his earlier quests. There are 8 large bank jobs in total and the 100% checklist wants all of them, so 5 comes naturally; each vault pays up to $205,000 and instantly gives a 4-star wanted level, so escape on a fast bike and switch cars to shake the heat.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: The same Chapter 4 optional mission, That's Where The Money Is, unlocks this one: robbing a large bank vault counts as robbing an armored truck, since you tail the truck to the bank first. If you want it earlier, block an armored truck driving near a bank in Vice City, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it open — sticky bombs sit in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests — then escape the red heat radius and it pops.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Unfog the whole map — all 52 areas of Leonida. The fastest way is by plane: fly over every patch of black fog until the map is fully visible. It pairs naturally with the vehicle scanning and stunt work of Stage 2, since you are crossing the state anyway.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation for each of the 9 gangs; PowerPyx counts 39 operations in total, and the 100% checklist wants every one of them, so this trophy falls out of that grind. Operations show as yellow icons when you get near them, and many get marked automatically as the story progresses. Track each gang's count under Progress, Gangs.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar, buy an Apple Martini, and drink it while standing next to the bar with the view in front of you. It is a quick Stage 3 cleanup trophy — no questline, no count, just the one drink.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Steal the blue Banshee from the vehicle showroom in the south of Vice City and drive it straight out through the showroom window. You need the Key Cloner first, from Chapter 3's Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs — hack into the car, drive forward through the glass, and the trophy pops a moment later once you are out on the street. Only this specific blue Banshee counts; it is a nod to the Banshee from GTA III.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Rob all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, one of the gang operations: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway, which takes sticky bombs (buy them at Ammu-Nation first). The trophy pops after you escape the police, not when you grab the third item — and it is not missable: if you miss something during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling, the robbery icon respawns later and you can go back for the rest.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Reach maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time, and keep it there. You can only start after Chapter 2's Coffee Break, when you can switch between both characters. Work out at a fitness club — filter for them on the map under Activities — and always bring your partner along (hold Right plus Triangle to call them): while one of you trains, the other completes their training automatically, so you progress twice as fast. Check strength under Touchpad, Jason and Lucia, then the heart icon. Home workouts work after the story too.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that move your criminal profile — click the trophy in the game's trophy list to see your count. Turn on criminal profile notifications (Settings, UI, HUD Notifications, Criminal Profile) so a small demon face flags each one: finishing objectives and robberies cleanly pushes you Professional, incapacitating enemies without killing them pushes Hardened, killing pushes Violent, and mass killing pushes Psycho. It comes passively while you work the other trophies; if it is the last one standing, it farms quickly, but do not push into Irredeemable — that status is permanent and makes the police far more aggressive.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Honest answer: nobody has pinned this one down yet. PowerPyx lists it as currently unknown, believed to be related to the Payday Loans store from the prologue. Do not chase a guessed method — check the linked PowerPyx guide for updates as players confirm it, and treat any method without a source as unconfirmed.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Finish the UFO easter egg. Go alone, at night after 2AM, to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County. Sometimes a blinking car waits at the roadside: if it is there, follow the path from it into the woods and you will see the UFO's bright blue light in the sky. Approach it, and it drops the woman it abducted — talk to her, offer to help, and walk her back to her car at the roadside. The spawn is random, so if no car is there, drive away and come back later.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Ride a motorcycle or a push bike and kick 10 pedestrians with Square within 60 seconds. Crowded streets are the place for it — Vice City or Ocean Beach — where you can chain the kicks without hunting for targets. It is a quick Stage 3 cleanup trophy once the counter starts.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of marked bills in total — it counts across robberies, not in one trip. First finish Chapter 3's Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew), which unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer, then rob banks and Payday Loans and carry the marked bills to a fence; Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The bank vaults alone pay up to $205,000 a robbery, so this lands naturally while you work Maximum Withdrawal and the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in total across every kind of shop. The fastest way is the expensive stuff — guns, car mods and tattoos — rather than clothes or snacks. It counts across the whole game, so by Stage 3 you will usually be close already; top it up at an Ammu-Nation or a mod shop.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages for $160,000 in total. They go on sale after Chapter 2's Daily Driver, when the Vice City Real Estate app lands on your phone — buy them through the app. (Four more garages come from the story and do not count.) Robberies are the quick way to the money, especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3 and 4.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app, which installs on your phone after Chapter 2's Moses mission. Buy garages first — Little Boxes — because each garage adds the parking spots you need to register more vehicles. Then drive a stolen vehicle to Moses in Port Gellhorn and choose Respray and Register in his garage. At first he only takes vehicles without trackers; from Chapter 3 you can also register cars with standard trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registration costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes.
